data.title: 埃塔 · 白大褂下的自体数据
data.description: 深夜的实验室，埃塔敞开白大褂，对着镜子记录自己穿着史莱姆衣的身体数据。美其名曰“基准样本采集”——反正经费申请单上，她就是这么写的。她打着哈欠，把围度数字精确到小数点后一位。
data.location: 阴影庭园地下实验室·深夜
data.action: 敞开白大褂站在镜前，用软尺量着腰围，睡眼惺忪地记录
data.lighting: cold white lab lamps and monitor glow
data.camera: medium shot, front view toward mirror
data.promptProse: In the midnight lab, adult Eta stands before a mirror in an open lab coat over her slime clothes, measuring herself with a tape for 'baseline sample data', yawning over the numbers.
data.animaCaption: Baseline sample: herself. Eta measures, yawns, and writes down numbers no one else will ever check.
